title: Uncrossed Lines
description: Find the maximum number of connecting lines that can be drawn between two arrays without crossing, where lines connect indices i and j if nums1[i] == nums2[j].

steps.note: Initialize DP table with size (n+1) x (m+1) filled with zeros.
Compare nums1[0]=1 and nums2[0]=1. Match found, set dp[1][1] = 1 + dp[0][0].
Compare nums1[0]=1 and nums2[1]=2. No match, take max(dp[0][1], dp[1][0]).
Compare nums1[1]=2 and nums2[0]=1. No match, take max(dp[1][0], dp[2][0]).
Compare nums1[1]=2 and nums2[1]=2. Match found, set dp[2][2] = 1 + dp[1][1] = 2.
